implementation.source: BF16 -> rowwise E4M3 pow2 quantization, or unchanged FP8+scale copy, directly into symmetric source packets; concurrent with CTA0 mini notify inside DT; existing BeforePull publishes both
implementation.compute: M16 mma.sync FP8; M64 WGMMA FP8 N64 partials; scale promotion every K128, FP32 totals; FC1/FC2 N256
implementation.activation: Full 128-channel gate/up blocks; preserve BF16 and FP8 AB rounding, gated SwiGLU, BF16 round then rowwise FP8 S
implementation.registers: Fixed math224/control56, after source/notify/geometry; no model-specific tuning
implementation.api: TensorRuntime.forward_fp8; TensorRuntime.inference_fp8 for warmed stable-address CUDA graphs; inference-only DT, single node

selection: Keep FC1/FC2 N256 and hoisted scale products. Reject bulk-copy pull: geometric mean speedup across 21 points was only 1.0069x, with Qwen35B regressions up to about 2.4%; retain the simpler vector pull and no extra tuning switch.
profile_caveat: Device phase clocks from one-shot eager launches include inter-rank launch skew and overlap; do not sum phases or substitute these values for the interleaved CUDA-graph benchmark.
methodology: Single-node EP8. Per case: one warm sweep then six timed sweeps in alternating variant order; each measurement is 50 graph calls averaged, reduce max across ranks, report median. Includes source preparation, notify, dispatch, both GEMMs, activation, BF16 return/combine. Weight preparation excluded; prequant input prepared before measurement. Final and *-random logs use uniform random top-k without replacement, fixed within timed replay; earlier exploratory logs use cyclic contiguous routing. Synthetic routed layer, steady state; no attention, shared expert or host scheduling. Profile runs are excluded from final timing comparisons.

limitations: DT backward and multi-node transport remain out of scope; use PF for training/multi-node.
FP8 E4M3 GEMMs and extra activation rounding change values versus BF16; no convergence evaluation.
M16 and M64 use different MMA accumulation paths; small-batch comparisons with the standalone FP8 WGMMA reference allow 2% relative L2, larger batches 1%.
Earlier timing variants are exploratory; only compare variants with matching routing policy.
